interpretation: Nearby pre-staging comparison: D repeated first with the same original DLL/Host, followed by a complete original-A repeat. B/C retain their earlier measurements. Residual PSX warm-rotation regressions remain in street/city/forest, despite faster geometry preparation; upload and command-recording delays are the observed hot path. This records source42 behavior and does not measure the later source7fd retained-staging candidate. All initial negative R1/R2 samples remain published.
